_comment: DesktopFrame componentization refactor — extract shared DesktopFrame so the hybrid desktop == SourcePrep desktop by construction. Text-only Playwright (no image reads), 1600x1000 + 375x812.
change: Extracted DesktopFrame (chrome: border, top bar, aspect-[1078/799], content area; width via className). DesktopBrowserMockup now composes it (className='w-[110%] lg:translate-x-6'). HybridDesktopPhonesMockup state-2 now composes it (className='w-[110%]') inside a w-full clip container, dropping the bespoke StaticDesktop.
rootCause: DesktopBrowserMockup was a monolith (column wrapper + desktop frame chrome + xPercent inner welded). The desktop frame chrome was never shared, so the hybrid reinvented a bespoke StaticDesktop at w-[85%] — smaller than SourcePrep's w-[110%].
keyInsight: SourcePrep's column is `flex items-center justify-center`, so its w-[110%] desktop is a flex item that flex-SHRINKS to the column width (634) — the w-[110%] never actually rendered at 110%. The hybrid reproduces the SAME flex-clamp by giving its desktop the same w-[110%] class inside a flex-row state cell whose width == the column width (clip container is w-full, not w-[110%]). Same component + same width class + same flex-clamp = identical rendered size. (An earlier attempt used w-[110%] on BOTH the clip container and the desktop -> 121% double-amplification (697px); corrected to apply the width once via the desktop's own class.)

desktop_1600x1000.note: Both use <DesktopFrame> with w-[110%], flex-clamped to the column width. Identical size by construction.
